details.name: Improvement: root-cause share
details.message: Fixing causes: 66% of the 403 cards finished this week fixed a cause or added a system, the rest fixed one more case of a repeat problem (last week 58%). 60 problems keep coming back; 49 have a card to fix the cause, 11 more get one over the next days. 6 fixes claimed to stop a repeat, and it came back anyway. 1 problem came back after the card fixing the cause was closed. An independent check of 8 fixes from this week, reading only the code, found 8 of 8 fixed the cause.

details.name: Improvement: done claims that held
details.message: Done claims that held: 92% (765 of 829) over 30 days, 87% (130 of 150) over 7 days; 11 more could not be checked on the recheck machine. On the first independent check: 88% (736 of 834).
